learned: English Education is about how people learn a language and how to teach it well. You study language, design lessons, practise teaching, and learn to adapt to different learners.

ladder.note: You teach classes with support, plan lessons, and learn from experienced colleagues. Some places require a teaching certification.

ladder.roles: Experienced teacher, curriculum developer, language trainer
ladder.note: You design courses and materials, mentor newer teachers, and specialize in an age group or skill.

ladder.roles: Head of department, school leader, teacher trainer, education consultant
ladder.note: You guide other teachers, shape programs, and help improve teaching across a school or organization.

outlook: Teachers are needed in many settings, from schools to online platforms and companies. Conditions and requirements vary by country and level, so check local sources before planning your path.
